gloss: way of writing, how to write

definitions.gloss: way of writing, how to write, writing style
definitions.explanation: The method, manner, or technique of writing something. Covers both the physical act of forming characters and the stylistic approach to composing text.

examples.japanese: この{漢字|かんじ}の{書|か}き{方|かた}を{教|おし}えて。
examples.english: Teach me how to write this kanji.

examples.japanese: {履歴書|りれきしょ}の{書|か}き{方|かた}がわからない。
examples.english: I don't know how to write a résumé.

examples.japanese: {小学校|しょうがっこう}では{正|ただ}しい{書|か}き{方|かた}を{一|いち}から{習|なら}うので、{書|か}き{順|じゅん}も{大切|たいせつ}にされる。
examples.english: In elementary school, students learn correct writing from the basics, so stroke order is also valued.

notes:
USAGE:
{書|か}き{方|かた} follows the productive pattern of verb stem + {方|かた} (way of doing). It can refer to physical penmanship, stroke order, or the compositional approach to writing documents, letters, or essays.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {漢字|かんじ}の{書|か}き{方|かた}: how to write kanji
- {手紙|てがみ}の{書|か}き{方|かた}: how to write a letter
- {履歴書|りれきしょ}の{書|か}き{方|かた}: how to write a résumé
- {正|ただ}しい{書|か}き{方|かた}: correct way of writing
- {書|か}き{方|かた}{教室|きょうしつ}: penmanship class

NOTE:
In elementary education, {書|か}き{方|かた} often refers specifically to penmanship or calligraphy practice, as distinct from {作文|さくぶん} (composition/essay writing).
